status: development model frozen; prospective validation pending
reason_for_parsimony: GNM marginally raises protein-macro AUROC but degrades AP/early/spatial recovery; APBS is case-specific and not globally beneficial; radial/RIN fail broader protein-level generalization and can erode chemistry specificity in the intentional wrong-chemistry negative control.
prospective_holdout_policy: No formula, parameter, chemistry-rule or cutoff changes after holdout outcomes are inspected. Any change requires a new model version and a new untouched holdout.
